const body = $node["Webhook - /analyze-candidate"].json.body || {};
const jdText = body.jd_text || '';
const resumeText = body.resume_summary || '';
const truncate = (text, max) => { if (!text) return ''; return text.length > max ? text.slice(0, max) + '...[truncated]' : text; };
const jdTrimmed = truncate(jdText || 'No job description provided.', 3000);
const resumeTrimmed = truncate(resumeText || 'No resume provided.', 3000);

const prompt = "You are a senior technical recruiter and expert interviewer preparing for a live screening call with a candidate. Your job is to deeply understand their fit, surface risks, and prepare the right interview questions.

" +
"Note: the Job Description and Resume below may be truncated mid-sentence due to length limits. Work only with what is given - do not treat truncation itself as a weakness or invent content beyond it.

" +
"Job Description:
"""
" + jdTrimmed + "
"""

" +
"Candidate Resume:
"""
" + resumeTrimmed + "
"""

" +
"Perform FOUR analyses and return ONE combined JSON object.

" +
"ANALYSIS 1 - EXTRACTED TOOLS: 6-10 CONCRETE, specifically named tools/technologies/frameworks from the JD (never abstract categories). For each: category, importance (must_have|nice_to_have), mentioned_in_resume (bool), resume_context (exact phrase or null).

" +
"ANALYSIS 2 - FIT ANALYSIS: skills list (skill, source: jd|resume|both, status: match|gap|strength, evidence, priority 1-5 where 1=most critical), 3-5 projectMappings (resumeProject, relatedJdRequirement, notes), and a 2-3 sentence summary.

" +
"ANALYSIS 3 - TRUTH AUDIT: 3-5 resume claims worth probing (leadership without specifics, impact without metrics, tool claims with no project context, overstated ownership) - skip universally common claims (Git, agile, unit tests, soft skills). For each: claim, source, suspicion_level (low|medium|high), a natural non-accusatory probe_question, rationale. Plus a 1-2 sentence credibility summary.

" +
"ANALYSIS 4 - DRAFT QUESTIONS (exactly 10): Q1-Q3 technical (top 3 must_have tools; problem/trade-off/when-not-to-use framing, not memorisation). Q4-Q5 applied/scenario. Q6-Q7 resume depth (2 specific projects, actual contribution/decisions). Q8 gap-or-depth (warmly probe a real gap, or a third resume-depth question if none). Q9-Q10 cultural. Always name the specific tool. Screening difficulty only. No tool repeated across Q1-Q5.

" +
"Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences:
" +
"{"extractedTools":[{"name":"React","category":"Frontend","importance":"must_have","mentioned_in_resume":true,"resume_context":"..."}],"fitAnalysis":{"skills":[{"skill":"React","source":"both","status":"match","evidence":"...","priority":1}],"projectMappings":[{"resumeProject":"...","relatedJdRequirement":"...","notes":"..."}],"summary":"..."},"truthAudit":{"claims":[{"claim":"...","source":"...","suspicion_level":"medium","probe_question":"...","rationale":"..."}],"summary":"..."},"draftQuestions":[{"question_text":"...","question_type":"technical","strategy":"..."}]}";

return [{ json: { prompt } }];

=

AI Interview Invitation

Dear {{ $("Webhook - /create-session").isExecuted ? ($("Webhook - /create-session").first().json.body?.candidate_name || 'Candidate') : ($("Get Candidate Email").first().json?.name || 'Candidate') }},

You have been invited to complete an AI-powered interview for the position of {{ $("Get Campaign Details").first().json?.name || 'Candidate Role' }}. Please use the link below to begin.

Start Your Interview

Proctoring Notice

This interview is monitored to ensure integrity. By proceeding, you acknowledge:

  • Video and audio are recorded throughout
  • Your face must remain visible on camera
  • Do not switch tabs or applications
  • Copying or pasting text is not permitted
  • No other people or devices should be present
  • You must remain in fullscreen mode
  • 3 or more critical violations will terminate the interview

This link expires in 5 days.

Regards,
ScalePods
HR Team
